what: Several customer logo slots (8 in the Hero row, 6 in the phone row) share one pool of logos and each swaps on its own. Near the screen, each slot starts .2s later than the last. A logo rises from 8px blur and 10px below over .55s power1.out, stays for the rest of the 3s cycle (2.05s), then leaves 10px upward with 6px blur over .4s. The next logo is picked at random from the first third of the pool among those not currently shown in another slot, so the same logo never appears in two slots

options.pause: Extra seconds added to each cell’s dwell time, default 0
options.blur: Blur before rising (px), default 8 — 3/4 of it when leaving
options.[data-fx-part=pool]: Logo group container (hidden) — inner [data-fx-part=Copies logo] into the cell and shows it

use: LOGO 1LOGO 2

from.where: index.html .hm-logos·.md-logos — client logo row on the Hero and the phone row of the logo section
